lines: The Spring 2027 recognition process is now open.
All student organizations must complete recognition
through the online portal, on an annual basis.
Recognition status runs for one academic year.
If you hope to re-establish your club, submit this form.
If you need accessibility accommodations or have questions, please contact us.
The recognition application is submitted on EngageSC by an officer of the club.
